non_claims: This is a reachability and adjudication measurement, not a memory-safety proof, not a re-audit of any receipt, and not a SAFE_COMPATIBLE promotion.
DISCHARGED means an existing committed receipt covers the exact site; nothing here was re-audited or independently reviewed.
The closure is a function-level linked-code upper bound, not a whole-program or source-level call graph; inlined callees are attributed to their caller.
The consumer side is modelled only as an import-root set; consumer-side dynamic lookup is not analysed.

No crate build, test, Miri, ASan, clippy or cryptographic court was run for this measurement; the only executions were the two openssh builds, the L7 workloads and the closure/union graph runs, all in the expand court container.
The L7 row's container_image field names the manifest's primary image, not the expand tag that actually ran; see l7_compatibility.venue_caveat.
The 78 excluded production operations are excluded only because their files are not reachable in this exact linked code; they remain part of the campaign's debt.
